title: Police Seize 545 kg Opium, Arrest Veteran Trafficker on Tehran's Azadegan Highway
text:
Police Seize 545 kg Opium, Arrest Veteran Trafficker on Tehran's Azadegan Highway"

""
"A 545-kilogram consignment of opium was seized during a special operation by the Greater Tehran Anti-Narcotics Police on the Azadegan Highway, leading to the arrest of a veteran drug trafficker. "

"The operation, which involved round-the-clock surveillance and comprehensive intelligence-gathering by the officers, successfully thwarted the shipment before it could reach its intended destination.
